# Pinterest Switzerland (Russian)

> > Swiss Pinterest platform offering creative ideas, DIY tutorials, and cultural content primarily in Russian, covering art, crafts, language learning, and regional heritage.

This is the Swiss localization (ch.pinterest.com) of Pinterest serving Russian-speaking users with curated boards and idea collections spanning creative arts, educational resources, handicrafts, and cultural topics related to the Caucasus region, Ossetia, and Kabardino-Balkaria.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest boards and profiles
- Marker drawing and easy art tutorials
- English alphabet learning resources
- Crochet patterns and knitting schemes
- Caucasus cultural heritage
- Kabardino-Balkaria traditions
- North Ossetia (Алания)
- DIY and handicraft projects
- Language learning materials
- Regional cultural content
- Beginner drawing ideas
- Simple sketches and doodle art
- Social media content curation

## Creative Arts & Drawing Ideas

- [Легкие Рисунки Маркерами](https://ch.pinterest.com/ideas/легкие-рисунки-маркерами/944075510710/): Ideas collection for easy marker drawings and beginner art tutorials

## DIY & Handicrafts

- [Связать Сумку Крючком Схема](https://ch.pinterest.com/ideas/связать-сумку-крючком-схема/929568605700/): Crochet bag patterns and DIY handbag knitting scheme ideas

## Educational Resources

- [Алфавит Английского Языка](https://ch.pinterest.com/ideas/алфавит-английского-языка/906512617527/): English alphabet learning ideas and educational resources in Russian

## Optional

- [Iskra Profile](https://ch.pinterest.com/iskra_electrical/): User profile page for Iskra showcasing personal Pinterest content
- [Кабардино-Балкарич Board](https://ch.pinterest.com/380502310087a/кабардино-балкарич/): Anna Matyagina's board on Kabardino-Balkaria culture and heritage
